protocol.map: two rooms, sole bridge cell (9,6), charger stubs do not bypass bridge
protocol.tasks: three opposing journeys, announced to only AMR-01; distributed auction; simultaneous motion release
protocol.allocation: same frozen guarded MLP and quorum ownership in both arms
protocol.energy: same per-move remaining-work + charging + reserve gate
protocol.motion: fresh pose/desired-step exchange, then proposals and local confirmation; negotiated head-on winner holds while loser yields; baseline preferred-cell-only
protocol.sharedPlanning: same A*, obstruction memory including unknown-contender safety envelope, and per-move energy gate
protocol.deployment: three OS processes on this host, peer-to-peer UDP, simulated sensors/time
protocol.controls: physics host advances time, supplies local contacts, audits moves; no route or movement-winner computation
protocol.performance: both-completed pairs only; end-to-end and motion-window ticks; capped failures excluded
protocol.network: connected; 8ms delivery opportunity, unknown/late contender means local hold; no delivery guarantee
